evidence.claim: Live evaluate() on platform/lib/completion_predicate.py returns C03=UNSATISFIED for a 0-byte file and C03=SATISFIED for a file whose independent stat() equals the declared floor (128 B).

Independent Path.stat().st_size of floor-1 / floor / floor+1 files matches the intended sizes, and C03 outcomes are UNSATISFIED / SATISFIED / SATISFIED. An alt declared floor of 80B is SATISFIED at exactly that size, so the threshold is read from min_bytes_threshold rather than hardcoded. A declared 40B floor at 40B is UNSATISFIED because ABSOLUTE_MIN_BYTES=64 is applied.

extensions.answer: Yes on the live shared reducer. C03 rejects 0 bytes, accepts exactly the declared floor (128 B and independently 80 B), rejects floor-1, and raises a sub-absolute declared 40 B floor to ABSOLUTE_MIN_BYTES=64. SUCCESS:TST-0143
